protein cookies are a delicious way to satisfy a sweet tooth while fueling your day with wholesome ingredients. Made with almond butter, vanilla protein powder, and a touch of maple syrup, the dough bakes into golden, chewy rounds studded with dark chocolate chunks and a sprinkle of coconut. They taste indulgent yet deliver steady energy. Quick to mix and ready in minutes, protein cookies are ideal as a post-workout snack, a lunchbox treat, or a healthy pick-me-up anytime. With simple prep and nourishing staples, they’re cookies you can feel great about enjoying.

Protein cookies

Discover the best protein cookies naturally for a delicious and healthy snack! Fuel your day with these tasty treats! 🍪💪
Print Recipe Pin Recipe
Prep Time 10 minutes mins
Cook Time 12 minutes mins
cooling 5 minutes mins
Total Time 27 minutes mins
Servings: 12 servings
Course: Snack
Cuisine: American
Calories: 150
Ingredients Equipment Method Notes

Ingredients
  

Dry Ingredients
  • 1 cup rolled oats Base for a chewy texture
  • 1 scoop vanilla whey protein powder Boosts protein content
Wet Ingredients
  • 1 ripe banana Natural sweetener and binder
  • 2 tablespoons peanut butter Adds creaminess and flavor
  • 1 tablespoon honey Sweetener for extra taste
  • 1/2 teaspoon baking powder Helps with rising
  • 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract Enhances flavor
  • pinch salt Balances sweetness
  • 2 tablespoons dark chocolate chips For a delightful chocolatey finish

Equipment

  • 1 Mixing bowl For combining ingredients
  • 1 Baking sheet For baking cookies
  • 1 spoon For scooping and flattening dough

Method
 

Preparation Steps
  1. Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). This will ensure your cookies bake evenly and come out perfectly golden.
  2. In a bowl, mash the ripe banana until it’s smooth and creamy. This will be the base of your cookies.
  3. Add peanut butter, honey, and vanilla extract to the mashed banana. Mix well until everything is combined and smooth.
  4. In a separate bowl, combine oats, protein powder, baking powder, and salt. Stir these dry ingredients together until well mixed.
  5. Gradually stir the dry mixture into the wet ingredients. Keep mixing until everything is fully combined and you have a thick dough.
  6. Gently fold in the chocolate chips. This is where the fun begins—chocolate makes everything better!
  7. Scoop tablespoon-sized portions of the dough onto a lined baking sheet. Flatten them slightly with the back of a spoon.
  8. Bake in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown. Your kitchen will smell amazing!
  9. Allow the cookies to cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack. Let them cool completely before indulging!

How to Make Protein Cookies

Get ready to whip up some delicious protein cookies! This recipe takes about 10 minutes to prepare and 10-12 minutes to bake. Allow an extra 5 minutes for cooling before you dive in!

Step 1: Preheat the Oven

Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). This will ensure your cookies bake evenly and come out perfectly golden.

Step 2: Mash the Banana

In a bowl, mash the ripe banana until it’s smooth and creamy. This will be the base of your cookies.

Step 3: Mix Wet Ingredients

Add peanut butter, honey, and vanilla extract to the mashed banana. Mix well until everything is combined and smooth.

Step 4: Combine Dry Ingredients

In a separate bowl, combine oats, protein powder, baking powder, and salt. Stir these dry ingredients together until well mixed.

Step 5: Mix Wet and Dry Ingredients

Gradually stir the dry mixture into the wet ingredients. Keep mixing until everything is fully combined and you have a thick dough.

Step 6: Fold in Chocolate Chips

Gently fold in the chocolate chips. This is where the fun begins—chocolate makes everything better!

Step 7: Scoop and Flatten

Scoop tablespoon-sized portions of the dough onto a lined baking sheet. Flatten them slightly with the back of a spoon.

Step 8: Bake the Cookies

Bake in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown. Your kitchen will smell amazing!

Step 9: Cool and Enjoy

Allow the cookies to cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack. Let them cool completely before indulging!

Recipe Snapshot

Pro Tips for Making Protein cookies

  • Choose a protein powder you love for the best flavor.
  • Experiment with nut butters for added richness.
  • Chill the dough for 30 minutes to enhance texture.
  • Mix in dark chocolate chips for a delightful treat.
  • Store in an airtight container to keep them fresh longer.

How to Serve this Protein Cookies

  • Enjoy them warm with a drizzle of almond butter on top.
  • Pair with a side of Greek yogurt for a protein-packed snack.
  • Crush them and sprinkle over smoothie bowls for added crunch.
  • Serve with a glass of almond milk for a delightful treat.

Make Ahead and Storage

Keep your protein cookies fresh and delicious with these simple storage tips:

Storing Protein Cookies Leftovers

  • Allow cookies to cool completely before storing.
  • Place in an airtight container to maintain freshness.
  • Store at room temperature for up to a week.
  • For longer storage, refrigerate for up to two weeks.

Freezing Protein Cookies

  • Wrap each cookie individually in plastic wrap.
  • Place wrapped cookies in a freezer-safe bag or container.
  • Label with the date for easy tracking.
  • Freeze for up to three months for best quality.

Reheating Protein Cookies

  • Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C).
  • Place cookies on a baking sheet for even heating.
  • Heat for about 5-7 minutes until warm.
  • Enjoy with a glass of milk or your favorite beverage!

FAQs

Here’s a helpful FAQ about this recipe:

1. Are protein cookies actually good for you?

Yes, protein cookies can be a healthy snack option, especially when made with wholesome ingredients. They provide a good source of protein, which can help with muscle repair and keep you feeling full longer. However, it’s important to check the ingredients and nutritional information, as some store-bought options may contain added sugars and unhealthy fats.

2. What is the best protein cookie?

The best protein cookie often depends on personal taste and dietary needs. Look for cookies that use high-quality protein sources like whey, pea, or almond protein, and are low in added sugars. Homemade options can also be tailored to your preferences, allowing you to control the ingredients and flavors.

3. How do you add protein to cookies?

You can add protein to cookies by incorporating protein powder into the dough. Start by replacing a portion of the flour with protein powder, or add it in addition to the flour. Other options include using nut butters, Greek yogurt, or even adding ingredients like chia seeds or hemp seeds for an extra protein boost.

4. What is the lawsuit against Lenny and Larry’s protein cookies?

Lenny and Larry’s faced a lawsuit regarding the protein content in their cookies, with claims that the actual protein levels were lower than what was advertised on the packaging. This raised concerns about misleading marketing practices. It’s always a good idea to check the nutritional information and ingredient list to ensure you’re getting what you expect from any product.

Final Thoughts

So there you have it—delicious protein cookies that are not only easy to make but also a joy to eat! Picture yourself enjoying these delightful treats, knowing they’re fueling your body. Grab your ingredients, get baking, and let the sweet aroma fill your kitchen. You’ll be amazed at how rewarding it is to whip up a batch of these tasty snacks!
